messages:
clara.prod: Quick note  were rolling out a cost-optimized Dedicated pool using NVIDIA A40s in eu-north-2 (Stockholm). Target: customers who need predictable price/per-token for mid-size models and embeddings.

clara.prod: This is not a raw performance play more of a volume/cost option for steady, medium-throughput workloads (e.g., embedding pipelines, ranking).

ben.eng: Tech summary: hosts are 4x A40 per server, tuned for steady-state throughput with aggressive batching and longer batch windows. Kernel set favors throughput over single-token tail latency.

ben.eng: Expected perf: roughly parity with our a800 baseline on 1-2k token jobs but at ~0.6x unit cost on typical embedding slices in our internal runs. Caveat: not ideal for single-token streaming or ultra-long-context instances.

jo.ops: Rollout plan: pool tag a40-eu-sto-cost-preview. Soft-preview live now with limited quota (20 hosts). GA planned in ~3 weeks after we validate utilization and cost signals. Preview is no SLA; billing tag: preview-a40-eu.

jo.ops: Please direct customers who want lower unit-cost routing to request seats via the preview form (internal link: https://internal.redwood/a40-preview).

finance-bot: [billing-note] preview-a40-eu tag applied to pool by jo.ops at 2026-07-08T10:04:12Z

emma.sales: Sales heads-up: Ill distribute an AE blurb highlighting target use-cases: embeddings at scale, batch re-ranking, non-interactive inference. Note limited capacity and approval workflow.

ben.eng: Ops checklist (short):
```
- Add a40-eu-sto-cost-preview to routing with fallback to a800-eu and l4p-eu.
- Default per-tenant unit cap = 4 devices; request increases via support.
- Enable aggressive batching (batch_window=150ms) and token-level cost metrics.
- Turn on cold-prefix cache warming for embedding pipelines.
```

ben.eng: Example redwoodctl command to reserve capacity for evals:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-a40-sto-01 --units 2 --duration 7d --justification "a40 cost preview eval"
```

devex-zoe: Ill add a short note to the Dedicated docs and the quickstart about when to pick A40 vs A800/H100. ETA EOD today.

clara.prod: Action items: Ben monitor cost-per-token and batch success rates; Jo publish weekly capacity snapshot in #eng-ops; Zoe update docs; Emma prep AE email. Post customer seat requests here so we can track.

jo.ops: Pool health: GREEN (all nodes reporting)

ben.eng: If you hit unexpected latency spikes after enabling aggressive batching, set header X-Force-NO-BATCH=1 and ping me with sample request id.

emma.sales: Will reach out to top 5 customers asking for cheaper embedding options.

clara.prod: Thanks team 
0 will follow up with an internal FAQ and the access form link in 24h.

deploy-bot: [capacity-event] created pool a40-eu-sto-cost-preview (pool-id: pool-a40-sto-01) by jo.ops at 2026-07-08T10:05:01Z

jo.ops: Note for billing: hold GA pricing until we have two weeks of stable telemetry and no major regressions.

finance-bot: [note] acknowledged
